analogy.rationale: Glucocorticoid receptor agonists act on NR3C1, a nuclear receptor; the closest transcriptional analogs are agonists of related steroid/nuclear receptors (mineralocorticoid, progesterone, androgen, estrogen, PPAR), though cross-reactivity and expression differences make responses weak to moderate.
